facts.fact: Paratus (press release republished by ITWeb Africa) says its 2,000km G2M fibre route from Mombasa via Nairobi, Kampala and Kigali to Goma was switched on and is live, linking Uganda to the Kenyan coast cable landings.
Paratus says G2M is already carrying traffic for its first wholesale customers and is designed for carriers, ISPs and enterprises.

systems.owner: Paratus Group (with Roke Telkom in Uganda)
